name: Art workshop
belongs: Visual work judged by how it looks: graphic and brand design, logos, ad creatives and social visuals, image and video generation prompts, photo retouching and upscaling, video editing, UI and layout critique, illustration and drawing.
not_here: Implementing a design in code or building a tool that generates visuals (Coding room). Ad copy, captions, budgets and campaign setup (Mail room). Compressing or downloading a file with no visual question (Mail room). Album or song work (Music studio).
examples: These photos look flat and grey, make them brighter and sharper
Give me a prompt for a striking, modern redesign of this homepage
The generated clip looks fake, make the ad more dynamic and exciting
Here are my app's screens, what should I remove, add or improve?
